title: An Empirical Analysis of Parameter-Efficient Methods for Debiasing Pre-Trained Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates religious bias alongside gender and racial bias in language models. It conducts specific experiments to measure religious stereotypes using benchmarks like CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet, and it utilizes a comprehensive list of religion-related attribute words (e.g., Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Torah, Bible, Quran) for its counterfactual data augmentation methodology.
